entities.name: EPS update status
entities.description: Status pertaining to a specific subscriber that describes the UE behavior. Stored in non-volatile memory in USIM if available, otherwise in ME.

entities.name: EU1: UPDATE SUCCESSFUL
entities.description: Indicates the last attach or tracking area updating attempt was successful.

entities.name: EU2: UPDATE FAILED
entities.description: Indicates the last attach, service request or tracking area updating attempt failed procedurally, e.g., no response or reject message was received from the MME.

entities.name: EU3: ROAMING NOT ALLOWED
entities.description: Indicates the last attach, service request or tracking area updating attempt was correctly performed, but the answer from the MME was negative due to roaming or subscription restrictions.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Timer that when running, a change in TAI not part of TAI list can trigger EPS update status change.

entities.name: Procedures triggering EPS update status change
entities.description: Set of procedures that can change the EPS update status value: attach, combined attach, network initiated detach, authentication, tracking area update, combined tracking area update, service request, paging for EPS services using IMSI.

relations.description: EPS update status can be guarded by condition EU1 indicating successful update.
EPS update status can be guarded by condition EU2 indicating procedural failure.
EPS update status can be guarded by condition EU3 indicating roaming not allowed.
Execution of listed procedures establishes a change in EPS update status value.
When timer T3346 is running, a TAI change not in TAI list can trigger EPS update status change.
